limitations: Lab rendering is detached. These images are semantic projections of sim poses and package metadata, not GPU frames.
Frame half-extents follow camera.js clampFocusToPlayerSafeRect (fov, zoom, 0.72, 16:9). A tilted frustum can show more ground than this safe rect.
Pixel, exposure, anti-alias, and compositor differences are review items. They do not fail the build.
Stations, gates, beacons, and landmarks are joined from authored sector anchors because the flight-lab bundle does not call world.enterSector.
Asteroid rings use the production place id and size range at the authored field center. They are not a second scatter simulation.
Shield hit points are not on the lab checkpoint surface. Shield discs use the ship or enemy def shield stat with coverage 0.22.
No WebGL context is created. runtimeFps is null. captureCostMs is witness wall time, not a frame-time measurement.
Whole-ship LOD runtime demotion is off. Census LOD outline flags are review items, not drawn swaps.

issues.expected: place or package id on the checkpoint
issues.summary: The lab checkpoint keeps defId only. These entities have no package id on that surface, so a missing model is not claimed. ADAPTER.md names the live hook that would copy it.

critique.summary: Critique tried 29 ways to disprove the detector. Planted faults were caught, benign contacts were allowed, and pixel drift stayed a review item.

attempts.detail: pixel hash change stays a review item
object order does not change the high-fail count
a witness with no player fails closed
a non-finite pose is bad bounds
a duplicate object id is bad initialization
tolerances stay on the flight-plane stick and the published ratios

gpu.note: detectGpu(null) reports unknown because this process does not create a WebGL context. No frame rate is claimed.

capture.pixels: semantic SVG projection, not a GPU frame
capture.diagnostics: window.__THREE_GAME_DIAGNOSTICS__ has draw counters and no object ids. See ADAPTER.md.
